value_or_angle: header="Three generations pulled back to New Jersey" body="His great-grandparents James and Eliza left the Cory homestead in the Westfields of New Jersey for the newly opening country in Ohio. His father Lewis took a Columbia law degree in 1883 and married Carrie Martin out of those same Westfields. Benjamin was born in Fresno and named for his doctor grandfather, and he went back east himself, to Princeton and then Harvard Law." category=family
